title: Offline waiting payments show their time by the computer clock, not India time
what: The list of payments waiting to send shows each one's time and decides whether it was today using the computer's own time zone. On a desk computer left on another zone the time is hours off and a payment from today can show yesterday's date. The rest of the admin app uses the India day.
expected: Waiting payments show India time and the India day, like receipts and the rest of the app.
who: front desk on a computer set to another time zone
how_often: every time on such a computer
fix_line: Use the shared India time rule for these times and the today check

title: The date on MettleUp news in the bell has its own copy of the India-day rule
what: The date shown on MettleUp's messages works out the India day with its own sum instead of the shared India date rule, and no test checks it. Today it gives the same answer, but a change to one copy will not reach the other.
expected: One India-day rule used everywhere, with a test.
how_often: never wrong today; risk on later changes
fix_line: Use the shared India date rule for the message date

title: Most of the admin app's shared screen parts are never loaded by any test
what: 43 of the 51 shared screen files are imported by no test, including the stopped-paying line, Pay MettleUp online, the bell, the welcome screen, the member card and the Refresh button. The 9 tests that do touch this folder check only small word and layout helpers.
expected: At least the money, lock-out and first-run parts have a test that checks what the person sees.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the stopped-paying line, pay online, bell and welcome first
